<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# H7: Player moves only through WALL cells (2 cells per action). 
# Player at (5,6), stuck because LEFT/DOWN lead to empty cells.
# RIGHT leads through walls (5,7)=#, (5,8)=# - should work!

print(f"RIGHT: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
player_pos = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        br, bc = n['boundary'][0]
        gr = (br - 21) // 3
        gc = (bc - 12) // 3
        player_pos = (gr, gc)
        break
print(f"Player at: {player_pos}")

# Rebuild grid
grid = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] <= 9:
        br, bc = n['boundary'][0]
        gr = (br - 21) // 3
        gc = (bc - 12) // 3
        symbol = n['color']
        if n['color'] == 'b':
            symbol = 'P'
        elif n['color'] == 'N':
            symbol = 'G'
        elif n['color'] in ('W', 'g'):
            symbol = '#'
        elif n['color'] == 'B':
            symbol = 'D'
        elif n['color'] == 'p':
            symbol = 'p'
        elif n['color'] == 'c':
            symbol = 'c'
        grid[(gr, gc)] = symbol

    row = ''

</function>
</tool_call>
